newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Mar 21- Apr 10 IGP-M index rises 0.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Mar 21- Apr 10 IGP-M index rises 0.54 pct.

text.p: Brazilian inflation between March 21 and April 10 slowed to 0.54 percent, from 0.97 percent between Feb 21 and March 10 as measured by the IGP-M index released by the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV).
The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators.

They are the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.48 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.57 percent in the period, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.69 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over ten-day intervals is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
